primitives.name: Customer Data Integrity Policy
primitives.verbatim_quote: **No fabricated data on customer surfaces.** Every customer-facing page that shows a record, win-rate, or claim must source it from `evaluatePublicPerformancePolicy()` in `apps/web/lib/performance/public-performance-policy.ts` (or be server-side gated by `getReadinessGates()`).
primitives.assumptions: All customer data originates from validated policy functions or server-side gates.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When D ∉ P or S = false, data integrity fails.

layer2.mapping: Public data sources map to policy-driven validation kernels in GSI.
layer2.telemetry: CI failure on unauthorized data exposure.

primitives.name: Public Copy Trust Registry
primitives.verbatim_quote: **No banned phrases on public copy.** The trust-claim registry in `apps/web/lib/trust-claims.ts` lists every banned phrase.
primitives.assumptions: Every public copy must be checked against T for B ∈ C.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If B ⊂ C and B ∈ T, then C is invalid.

layer2.mapping: Registry-based phrase filtering maps to kernelized trust constraints in GSI.
layer2.telemetry: CI tests fail on banned phrase detection.

primitives.name: Bootstrap Performance Exclusion
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Bootstrap picks never count toward public performance.** Pick queries that feed customer surfaces must include `isBootstrap: false`.
primitives.assumptions: Only Q where B = false contributes to P.

layer2.mapping: Bootstrap exclusion mirrors kernelized data filtering in GSE.
